git add CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): run onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws

beforeSession was awaited before the try block opened, so a throw from it
escaped before the catch and finally existed: onError never fired and
afterSession never ran, leaking whatever the hook allocated. The call now
sits inside the try, so its throw reaches the same catch and finally as
any other failure in the turn. The rejection still reaches the caller.

afterSession fires with no flag distinguishing a failed beforeSession
from a completed turn; the spec records that answer and what the hook may
assume: only beforeSession ran.

Refs: re-cinq/HALEngine#94
